vote.title: To authorize an amendment to the 2022 Capital Improvement Budget; to authorize a transfer of cash and appropriation between projects within the Water Bond Fund and within the Sanitary Bond Fund; to authorize the Director of Public Utilities to enter into a contract for Construction Administration and Inspection Services with Resource International; and to authorize an expenditure of up to $540,123.70 from the Water Bond Fund and the Sanitary Bond Fund for the contract.  ($540,123.70)
vote.description: This item was approved on the Consent Agenda.
